name: @dayly/mac-status-item
description: Owns an NSStatusItem directly, so its highlight can be held while the panel is open.
//: os is load-bearing, not documentation. Without it npm installs this optional dependency everywhere, and `electron-builder install-app-deps` then hands the Objective-C++ target to MSBuild on Windows, which fails the whole install. Restricting it to darwin means the package is simply never fetched off macOS, so node-gyp never runs there.
